verdict.rationale: Grafana's docs explicitly state it 'enables you to query, visualize, alert on, and explore your metrics, logs, and traces wherever they're stored' with cross-source alerting, exemplar-based jump from metrics to traces, log/metric label-preserving pivots, and unified incident investigation using the same metrics/logs/traces that fired an alert. Community evidence corroborates real-world use spanning multiple metric/log/trace backends unified in one alerting/visualization layer. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of seamless cross-signal pivoting UX (one community note flags gaps in dashboard/data documentation) and no third-party benchmark of trace-log-metric correlation accuracy.
